title.value: Maxton Hall: The World Between Us

logline: A scholarship student at an elite boarding school witnesses something she should not and becomes entangled with the wealthy heir whose world could erase everything she has worked for.

bollymeter.basis: 70% critics score on Rotten Tomatoes from 10 reviews, 91% audience score; reported as the most successful series launch of any non-American Prime Original ever. Critics divided between admiring the execution and dismissing the YA formula.

seasons.review_body: Maxton Hall: The World Between Us premiered May 9, 2024, on Prime Video Germany and rapidly became the most successful series launch of any non-American Prime Original in the platform's history - a viewership benchmark cited by Wikipedia and trade press. Critics on Rotten Tomatoes approved at 70 percent from ten reviews, with the audience score at a substantially stronger 91 percent from comparable data. Screen Rant characterised it as a must-watch series surging worldwide. The class-divide romance between scholarship student Ruby and wealthy heir James draws directly from the YA novel source material; critics found the execution competent where they found the genre familiar. The audience, particularly in Europe, embraced it with unusual enthusiasm.

Season 2 premiered November 7, 2025. Critical aggregates had not settled at the time of this entry. The season continues the Ruby-James storyline from Season 1, with the class conflict and family opposition further tested. Early audience response indicated the fanbase that drove Season 1's record launch remained engaged.
seasons.season_over_season: Season 2 deepens the central romance under greater external pressure; formal review aggregates were not yet established at entry date.
